name: tinyg
description: Synthetos TinyG controllers (TinyG v8, checked against the edge-next firmware at commit c551f405, build 450.03, by running its parser and planner on the posted text). TinyG rejects a word it does not know rather than skipping it: no tool table (G43 H is refused; only G43.1 and G49), no cutter compensation, no canned cycles, tool numbers 0 to 31. The header says G91.1 (I and J are relative to the arc's start; the firmware resets to that but a program can leave G90.1 behind), G49 (a G43.1 offset from an earlier program is not cleared by G54 or a tool number) and G64 (continuous path; an exact-stop mode set earlier would persist). A tool change is by hand: M6 only records the tool, so the post stops the spindle, selects the tool and writes M0, which halts queued execution until the operator resumes with the new tool measured. No wait is written after M3; a spindle start dwell belongs with the toolpath, where read-back accounts for it.
header: G17 {units} G90 G91.1 G94 {work_offset} G49 G64
